items.why: Volatility is spiking as stocks swoon on AI fears and investors rush to Treasuries, with the sell-off continuing on worries about AI, tariffs, and inflation.
Nvidia is leading the AI sell-off, and Jensen Huang's return failed to calm AI fears as the Nasdaq resumes its slide.
AMD is caught in the same AI-driven rout hitting chip names as confidence in the AI trade weakens.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as tech stocks bounce off lows and the Dow turns positive.

market_note: Futures mixed: Nasdaq futures down 1.26% while Dow futures are up 0.44%.
summary: The AI-led sell-off is still running, with chip names sliding and volatility jumping, though stocks are paring losses and the Dow has turned positive on the day.
